request: 你看看aide issue已经修复并合并到main的就关了吧
acceptance: Enumerate every currently open Aide issue and identify fixes merged to remote main with completed relevant verification.
Close only verified completed items, then read back remote states; preserve unresolved, partially fixed, unmerged and target-environment pending issues.
Record issue-to-fix and acceptance evidence without altering product code, existing local changes, services or release state.
scope: Read-only GitHub pull request, commit and CI metadata

requirements.summary: 110 open issues inventoried from live GitHub; 60 have complete PR609 fix and verification records, 50 retained.

design.summary: Match individual issues to cycles107-130, successful PR609 full CI, identical reviewed-head/merge tree and current-main ancestry; retain explicit acceptance gaps.

implementation.summary: Closed 60 verified issues as completed; no comment, label or product code changes.

verification.summary: 60/60 independently re-read closed/completed; 50/50 retained issues remain open. Remote main unchanged. 24 targeted current-main suites passed; historical PR609 full CI and component/browser evidence verified. Current overall main CI failure retained as a separate boundary.

documentation.summary: Recorded every closed/retained issue, fix PR, acceptance cycle, CI boundary and independent remote readback.

cleanup.summary: Only owned task/audit records and regenerable ignored evidence added; pre-existing start.command and other task worktrees preserved.

release.summary: Issue state cleanup only. No source commit, push, tag, release or runtime deployment.

rollback: Issue state changes are reversible by reopening individual issue numbers in the final audit.
handoff: Completed: 60 accepted PR609 fixes closed and independently confirmed; 50 unresolved, unmerged or target-environment pending issues remain open. 24 targeted current-main suites passed. No source commit/push, new merge, release or runtime change.
